best_for: Students and researchers who write in Word, keep a few gigabytes of PDFs, and want their library synced to the cloud through a free Elsevier-run account.
description:
Mendeley Reference Manager is a desktop library for the research papers you read and the references that go with them. It is made by Mendeley and is proprietary software that costs nothing to download.

Getting papers in takes little effort. Drag PDFs into the app one at a time, or bring in a whole folder in one go. Pick a folder on your computer as a watched folder, and each PDF you save there joins your library on its own. While you browse journal sites, the Mendeley Web Importer extension for your browser saves the reference on the page you are reading. The app also includes an Ask AI section.

points.title: An account is part of the deal
points.text: You sign in with Mendeley credentials and the library syncs to Mendeley's cloud. If you want a reference manager that works fully offline without an account, this is not it.

points.title: 2 GB free
points.text: A free account includes 2 GB of personal storage, up to 5 private groups of 25 people each, and 100 MB of shared storage across all groups. Extra space only comes through an upgrade, which adds personal storage, not group space.

points.title: Upgrade path now points to LeapSpace
points.text: Mendeley's premium link now leads to an Elsevier upgrade page for LeapSpace, listed at USD 320 a year for individuals, with a free tier. That page does not spell out Mendeley storage amounts, so check what you get before paying. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Citations in Word are a separate add-in
points.text: Citing while you write uses Mendeley Cite, an add-in for Microsoft Word installed from Microsoft AppSource. It inserts citations and builds the bibliography in the style you choose.

points.title: Read and annotate in the app
points.text: You can import papers, tag and organize them, and highlight and comment on PDFs. Mendeley Notebook collects notes across documents.

points.title: Moving from Mendeley Desktop
points.text: Users of the older Mendeley Desktop move over by syncing their library to the cloud, then installing Reference Manager and signing in.

points.title: Windows has the old versions
points.text: The Windows build needs Windows 10 or later and installs per user or for all users; that listing keeps 57 versions. macOS 12 or later gets a universal app with only the current release listed. Mendeley also makes a Linux version, not listed here.
